items.name: Leonxlnx/taste-skill
items.one_liner: API that evaluates and improves AI output distinctiveness, fighting generic slop
items.pain_point: AI outputs are increasingly generic and boring, hurting product differentiation. Solo devs and startups building AI products need outputs that feel human and distinctive, not robotic slop. They'd pay for tools that guarantee their AI feels original.
app_ideas: Taste Score API - endpoint developers call to score their AI outputs on genericness (0-100), with upgrade suggestions. Freemium at 1k calls/month.
AI Content Polish Chrome extension - users paste generic AI output, get one-click rewrite into more distinctive version. $5/month subscription.
Prompt Taste Injector - pre-processing layer that modifies prompts before sending to LLM APIs, injecting style/personality constraints. B2B SaaS at $29/month per seat.
items.monetization: Freemium B2B API wrapper with per-call pricing above free tier. Also works as browser extension with monthly subscription.
items.why_now: 73k stars with 5.57% weekly growth proves massive developer demand - AI slop is the #1 complaint about LLM outputs, and nobody's winning this category yet.
